d:
Yas Lions registered a convincing 29-run victory over Arabian Aces in the 12th match of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026!
Batting first, Yas Lions posted an impressive 132/5 in their 10 overs, setting Arabian Aces a target of 133.
In reply, Arabian Aces managed 103/7 in 10 overs as Yas Lions held their nerve to seal a 29-run victory.
Watch 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
